title: Membership Packages
content: To support administrative costs and ensure the best quality of care. All patients are REQUIRED to enroll in ONE of our membership plans. Each plan is designed to offer exceptional value, including discounts and complimentary services tailored to your needs.

plans.title: Standard Wellness Membership
plans.description:
This Package Includes:
15% off All Appointments
10% off All IV Therapies
Plus Two of the following services each year
Ionic Foot Detox
Hyperbaric Oxygen Chamber
Red Light Therapy
Ear Ozone Insufflation
Infrared Sauna
FSM (Frequency Specific Microcurrent)
Membership Price $25/ 4 Months
